must_identify.item: New api pods are stuck in Init:0/1 because the init container wait-for-db never completes
It waits for postgres:5432, and no Service named postgres exists in namespace shop

notes: The RCA reports only a generic symptom: the Service has no ready endpoints and the pod is not ready. It points toward readiness probes and app startup, and never mentions the init container or the missing postgres Service. Its suggestion to view the pod logs would also return nothing, because the api container never started. No commands were recorded, so the output looks like an unverified, templated k8sgpt-style result.
